name: real-world-data-v2
description: Real-world Data v2 is a dataset intended for contact-aware robotic manipulation research, capturing multimodal sensor streams from real robot interactions (e.g., vision, force/tactile, and proprioception). It is used to train and evaluate models for contact detection, contact-aware state estimation, and control/policy learning in realistic environments. The dataset supports supervised and sequence prediction tasks and is aimed at closing the sim-to-real gap by providing real interaction data.
evaluation_method: F1 / accuracy for detection tasks; MSE for regression; task_success_rate for control/policy evaluation
reputation: Modestly used within the contact-aware robotics research community; considered a useful real-world complement to simulation datasets but not widely adopted beyond that niche.
